post.title: 89% targeted by shopping scams lost money. The red flags
post.ig:
In 2025, 89% of people targeted by online shopping scams lost money (BBB).

Online purchase scams were 28.4% of BBB Scam Tracker reports in 2025; median loss $68.
All reported fraud losses to the FTC: $15.9B in 2025, up from $3.3B in 2020.
FTC red flags: prices too low, odd web addresses, payment by gift card/wire/crypto, no contact info. Credit cards carry federal dispute rights (generally 60 days from the statement); gift cards and wires are hard to reverse.

Sources: BBB 2025 Scam Tracker Risk Report; FTC Consumer Sentinel; Fair Credit Billing Act.
